title: Locale-Aware Plugin Manifest Labels
description: Window/panel-tab/mode/action titles are baked into each plugin's AppDefinition once at plugin-load time via a zero-argument WIT manifest() export, so they never react to locale/terminology even though render/tools/window_measures/window_engagements already do. Add a new, additive WIT export that returns a localized label overlay for an already-instantiated app (keyed by instance-id + ViewState, mirroring the existing list-tools/window-engagements contract shape), thread it through component.rs/lib.rs/the dev script.ts codegen templates, wire the shell to re-fetch and merge this overlay into session.app whenever uiLocale/uiTerminology change, and roll out a per-app resolver (reusing each app's existing Labels struct where one exists) across all plugin crates.
summary:
Made every remaining plugin-UI surface react to the language/terminology switch, closing the gaps the user reported ("still a lot of UI is not reacting to language or terminology... make sure to not miss anything").

Part A — manifest-label reactivity architecture (new gap: window-kind/panel-tab titles baked into the manifest at plugin-load time could never react to a runtime locale switch, unlike render/tools/engagements/measures which all take a per-call ViewState):
- Added a new additive WIT export `app-labels` (framework/wit/world.wit) mirroring the existing `window-measures` shape, returning an `AppLabelsOverlay` (window_kind_labels/panel_tab_labels/mode_labels maps) that the shell merges over the static manifest labels.
- Plumbed it end-to-end: framework/core/rs/lib.rs (AppLabelsOverlay type, framework_panel_tab_label helper), framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs (PluginApp::app_labels default method, plugin_app_labels runtime fn), framework/plugin/rs/component.rs (Guest impl), framework/plugin/host/rs/lib.rs (native-host stub), framework/product/os/dev/script.ts (JS bridge/worker codegen), framework/core/js/index.ts (PluginWasmHandle.appLabels + normalization), framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx (appLabelsOverlay state, resolveAppLabel helper, wired into panel tabs/mode switcher/command palette/window-kind titles).
- Implemented `app_labels()` overrides for CAD (proof of concept, 4 window panes: Shape/Building/Energy/Structure Classic) and then rolled the same pattern out via a Workflow to 18 more multi-window apps: flow, forms, imperative, layout, lowpoly, dag (mathematical/graph/port/directed/dag), note, raster, sequence, shooting, vcs, s (SStudioApp only), procedural (2d+3d), puzzle (d2+d5), trinity (jack+rewrite) — each got new native-EN/DE (and reuse-terminology where applicable, e.g. puzzle2d) label fields for its window titles plus an `app_labels` override wired to its existing labels resolver.
- Found and fixed a second, deeper bug during live verification: window pane titles are actually rendered from a static `title` string baked into each app's default `WindowLayoutWindowNode` (the named-layout tree), which is a completely separate field from `AppDefinition.windowKinds[].label` and was NOT being re-resolved by the overlay. Fixed by threading `appLabelsOverlay` through `convertFrameworkLayoutToModeLayout`/`convertFrameworkLayoutNodeToModeLayout` (all 8 call sites in os-shell.tsx) and adding a `retitleWindowLayoutNode` + dedicated `useEffect` that re-titles the live `shellLayout` and any spawned extra-window instances whenever the overlay changes (previously `shellLayout` was only rebuilt on session change, so an in-place language switch left pane titles stale even though the chrome and manifest labels updated correctly).
- Full-fleet plugin WASM rebuild (23 crates, `bun ./📜️script.ts plugin build`, no filter) — required since `app_labels` is a new required Guest trait method compiled into every plugin binary. All 23 built with zero errors.
- Verified live in the CAD playground (port 6020): switching Settings → Language between English/Deutsch now correctly retitles all four window panes ("Shape/Building/Energy/Structure Classic" ↔ "Form/Gebäude/Energie/Struktur Klassisch") both on fresh load and on an in-place switch with no reload, round-tripped back to English cleanly, zero console errors.
- cargo check clean across all touched crates (core/plugin/plugin-host/cad + all 15 rollout crates); all 55 cad-plugin tests pass; root tsc error count unchanged from pre-change baseline (fixed 3 genuine appLabels-missing-field regressions in test mocks in framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts and framework/renderer/wgpu/index.test.ts; remaining diffs are pure line-number shift noise in pre-existing unrelated errors).

Part B — OS-shell chrome i18n (completed earlier this session, reported here for a complete record): 26 new `shellLabel` schema keys and 24 call sites covering command palette, loading/error text, and panel-label chrome constants, verified typecheck-clean via before/after diff.

Files touched (Part A, this continuation): framework/wit/world.wit, framework/core/rs/lib.rs, framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs, framework/plugin/rs/component.rs, framework/plugin/host/rs/lib.rs, framework/product/os/dev/script.ts, framework/core/js/index.ts, framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx, framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts, framework/renderer/wgpu/index.test.ts, cad/plugin/rs/lib.rs, flow/plugin/rs/lib.rs, forms/plugin/rs/lib.rs, imperative/plugin/rs/lib.rs, layout/plugin/rs/lib.rs, lowpoly/plugin/rs/lib.rs, mathematical/graph/port/directed/dag/plugin/rs/lib.rs, note/plugin/rs/lib.rs, raster/plugin/rs/lib.rs, sequence/plugin/rs/lib.rs, shooting/plugin/rs/lib.rs, vcs/plugin/rs/lib.rs, s/plugin/rs/lib.rs, procedural/plugin/rs/app_2d.rs, procedural/plugin/rs/app_3d.rs, puzzle/plugin/rs/d2/mod.rs, puzzle/plugin/rs/d5/mod.rs, trinity/plugin/rs/app_jack.rs, trinity/plugin/rs/app_rewrite.rs.
